challenged_claim: In the r45/r46 same-bank puncture, a finite L^3 bound for the hyperbolic-plus-puncture component and a finite L^(3/2) bound for the determinant-tied third square can be combined into a universal L^infinity bound using only residual joint/marginal density caps and small puncture size.
correction: False. For every 0<eta<=1/sqrt(63), take independent centered unit uniforms H,R,V,W and set T=R-V^2/(2 eta W) off the null event W=0. The residual triple (T,V,W) has joint density cap 1 and all coordinate one/two-dimensional marginal caps <=1. The coefficient matrix of Q=2HW+2eta TW+V^2 has exact rank three, signature (2,1), spectrum {-sqrt(1+eta^2),0,1,sqrt(1+eta^2)}, hub leverage q=1/(1+eta^2)>=63/64, and matches the r45 determinant identity. Yet Q=2W(H+eta R), so p_Q(z)>=log((1-eta)/(2|z|)) near zero. Meanwhile r46 gives ||p_(2HW+2eta TW)||_3^3<=6 and ||p_(V^2)||_(3/2)=2. Thus same-source dependence defeats the dependence-blind L^3 x L^(3/2) step. This is not a QFORM counterexample because (T,V,W) is a nonlinear image of the independent cube, not an exhibited orthogonal linear projection of an original product source; pulled back to H,R,V,W the form has rank two. The true remaining proof must use orthogonal product-projection provenance before collapsing to marginal norms.
